title: Generated M4RI resource core v1
objective: Implement generated M4RI owned matrix and byte-region resources with checked scalar and canonical packed row-word operations, lifecycle safety, direct resource algorithms, architecture inventory, focused tests, and benchmarks without public matrix.py integration

oracles: M4RI direct resource differential tests against JavaScript GF(2) references

handoff.summary: Added a generated, opaque M4RI matrix resource and byte-region boundary with 22 declared operations, compact canonical logical row words, direct resource algebra, Python ownership wrappers, a source-transparent typed-Python traversal witness, focused differential tests, lifecycle/finalizer/sanitizer coverage, and a reproducible benchmark.
risks: Native Windows intentionally reports the M4RI capability unavailable and relies on the existing packed GF(2) fallback.
Linux x64 is validated here; Linux arm64 and macOS arm64 use the same pinned static build but still require CI confirmation.
The generated M4RI resources are not yet wired into the public Matrix class by design.
The inherited portable tier currently fails only because checked website reference data reports 21 unverified examples while the website test expects zero; b2cfa87 has the same unrelated failure.
next_steps: Integrate generated M4RI resources into public dense GF(2) matrix construction and operation selection.
Add CI coverage for macOS arm64 and Linux arm64, then evaluate a credible WASM lowering.
Use the direct resource benchmark as a performance floor while measuring the public crossover.
